# Setup

### Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(tigris)
library(kableExtra)
library(knitr)
library(readxl)
library(leaflet)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
```

### Data

```{r}
# Projection for the contiguous U.S.
crs_conus <- "ESRI:102003"

processors <- read_csv(
  here("data/cleaned/states-2024-streetgeo/active-processors-2024-streetgeo.csv")
)

coastal_counties <- st_read(
  here("data/raw/coastal_counties/enow_counties.shp")
) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    geoid   = str_pad(as.character(geoid), 5, pad = "0"),
    statefp = str_pad(as.character(statefp), 2, pad = "0")
  ) %>%
  st_transform(crs_conus)


products_24 <- read_excel(here("data/raw/pp_2024/PPS1999to2024.xlsx")) %>% 
  clean_names() %>% 
  filter(year == 2024)


products <- read_excel(here("data/raw/pp_2024/pp_names__1.xlsx")) %>% clean_names() 
```

# Processor county analysis

```{r}

# Contiguous US state only
non_contiguous <- c("AK", "HI", "AS", "GU", "MP", "PR", "UM", "VI")

contiguous_fips <- fips_codes %>%
  distinct(state, state_code) %>%
  filter(!state %in% non_contiguous) %>%
  pull(state_code)

coastal_counties_conus <- coastal_counties %>%
  filter(statefp %in% contiguous_fips)

# Convert processors to sf and keep only contiguous US points
processors_sf <- processors %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude),
    between(longitude, -125, -66),
    between(latitude, 24, 50)
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  st_transform(crs_conus)

# Assign a county to each processor
processors_county <- st_join(
  processors_sf,
  coastal_counties_conus,
  join = st_within
)

# Processors outside coastal counties
message(
  sum(is.na(processors_county$geoid)),
  " processors did not fall within a coastal county"
)



county_lookup <- coastal_counties_conus %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(geoid, namelsad, statefp) %>%
  left_join(
    fips_codes %>% distinct(state, state_code),
    by = c("statefp" = "state_code")
  ) %>%
  select(geoid, county = namelsad, state)

processor_counts <- processors_county %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(geoid)) %>%
  count(geoid, name = "n_processors") %>%
  left_join(county_lookup, by = "geoid") %>%
  select(geoid, county, state, n_processors) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_processors))

county_counts <- coastal_counties_conus %>%
  left_join(select(processor_counts, geoid, n_processors), by = "geoid") %>%
  mutate(n_processors = replace_na(n_processors, 0))
```

## Coastal Counties and Active Processors Map

```{r}
# Flag whether each processor landed inside a coastal county
processors_flagged <- processors_county %>%
  mutate(
    in_coastal = factor(
      if_else(is.na(geoid), "Outside coastal county", "In coastal county"),
      levels = c("In coastal county", "Outside coastal county")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(is.na(geoid)) 

# State outlines
states_conus <- states(cb = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!STUSPS %in% non_contiguous) %>%
  st_transform(crs_conus)

# Bounding box for contiguous US
conus_box <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -125, xmax = -66, ymin = 24, ymax = 50),
  crs = st_crs(4326)
) %>%
  st_as_sfc() %>%
  st_segmentize(units::set_units(50, km)) %>%
  st_transform(crs_conus)

# Crop states to the box
states_conus <- st_intersection(states_conus, conus_box)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = st_boundary(states_conus),
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = coastal_counties_conus,
    fill = NA,
    color = "steelblue4",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = processors_flagged,
    aes(color = in_coastal),
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "In coastal county"      = "#D73027",
      "Outside coastal county" = "black"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Active Seafood Processors in Coastal Counties (2024)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )
```

## Processor Counts map

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = st_boundary(states_conus),
    color = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
   geom_sf(
    data = county_counts,
    aes(fill = if_else(n_processors == 0, NA_real_, n_processors)),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "mako",
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Processors"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Active Seafood Processors per Coastal County (2024)"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )
```


```{r}
# Number of processors inside/outside coastal counties
n_coastal <- processors_county %>%
  filter(!is.na(geoid)) %>%
  nrow()

n_noncoastal <- processors_county %>%
  filter(is.na(geoid)) %>%
  nrow()

cat("### Processor Summary\n\n")
cat("Number of processors in coastal counties: ", n_coastal, "\n\n")
cat("Number of processors outside coastal counties: ", n_noncoastal, "\n\n")

kable(
  processor_counts,
  col.names = c("GEOID", "County", "State", "Processors"),
  caption = "Number of Active Seafood Processors by Coastal County"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")
  )
```



# Product Analysis - Poundage

### Specific Product by Poundage
```{r}
# Join product descriptions onto 2024 product data
products_24_named <- products_24 %>%
  left_join(
    product_names %>%
      select(
        pp_code,
        pp_dscp,
        type,
        species
      ),
    by = "pp_code"
  )

# Attach county GEOID to each processor's product records
products_county <- products_24_named %>%
  left_join(
    processors_county %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      mutate(pp_idnum = as.character(pp_idnum)) %>%
      select(pp_idnum, geoid),
    by = "pp_idnum"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(geoid))

# Summarize pounds by county and product
county_products <- products_county %>%
  group_by(geoid, pp_code, pp_dscp) %>%
  summarise(
    pounds = sum(pounds, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get top 3 products in each county based on pounds
top_3_products <- county_products %>%
  group_by(geoid) %>%
  arrange(desc(pounds), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  mutate(
    product_rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Put top 3 products into separate columns
top_3_products_text <- top_3_products %>%
  mutate(
    product = paste0(
      pp_dscp,
      " (",
      scales::comma(round(pounds)),
      " lbs)"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(geoid, product_rank, product) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = product_rank,
    values_from = product,
    names_prefix = "product_"
  )

# Combine processor counts with top products
county_summary <- processor_counts %>%
  filter(n_processors >= 3) %>%
  left_join(
    top_3_products_text,
    by = "geoid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("product_"),
      ~replace_na(.x, "No product data")
    )
  )


# Make table of top products
county_table <- county_summary %>%
  select(
    county,
    state,
    n_processors,
    product_1,
    product_2,
    product_3
  )

kable(
  county_table,
  col.names = c(
    "County",
    "State",
    "Processors",
    "Top Product",
    "2nd Product",
    "3rd Product"
  ),
  caption = "Coastal Counties with Three or More Active Seafood Processors, 2024"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c(
      "striped",
      "hover",
      "condensed"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# County polygons for interactive map
county_map <- coastal_counties_conus %>%
  left_join(
    county_summary %>%
      select(
        geoid,
        county,
        state,
        n_processors,
        product_1,
        product_2,
        product_3
      ),
    by = "geoid"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_processors)) %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Color scale based on number of processors
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = viridis(100, direction = -1),
  domain = county_map$n_processors,
  na.color = "transparent"
)
```


```{r}
leaflet(county_map) %>%
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
  
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(n_processors),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.7,
    
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#333333",
      fillOpacity = 0.9,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    
    # Hover info
    label = ~paste0(
      county, ", ", state,
      " | Processors: ", n_processors,
      " | Top products: ",
      product_1, "; ",
      product_2, "; ",
      product_3
    ) %>%
      lapply(htmltools::HTML),
    
    # Click info
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", county, ", ", state, "</strong><br><br>",
      "<strong>Active processors:</strong> ", n_processors,
      "<br><br>",
      "<strong>Top products:</strong><br>",
      "1. ", product_1, "<br>",
      "2. ", product_2, "<br>",
      "3. ", product_3
    )
  ) %>%
  
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~n_processors,
    title = "Active Processors",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

# Product Analysis - Revenue

### Specific Product by Revenue
```{r}
# Summarize dollars by county and product
county_products_revenue <- products_county %>%
  group_by(geoid, pp_code, pp_dscp) %>%
  summarise(
    dollars = sum(dollars, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Get top 3 products in each county based on dollars
top_3_products_revenue <- county_products_revenue %>%
  group_by(geoid) %>%
  arrange(desc(dollars), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  mutate(
    product_rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Put top 3 products into separate columns
top_3_products_revenue_text <- top_3_products_revenue %>%
  mutate(
    product = paste0(
      pp_dscp,
      " ($",
      scales::comma(round(dollars)),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(geoid, product_rank, product) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = product_rank,
    values_from = product,
    names_prefix = "product_"
  )

# Combine processor counts with top products
county_summary_revenue <- processor_counts %>%
  filter(n_processors >= 3) %>%
  left_join(
    top_3_products_revenue_text,
    by = "geoid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("product_"),
      ~replace_na(.x, "No product data")
    )
  )

# Make revenue table
county_table_revenue <- county_summary_revenue %>%
  select(
    county,
    state,
    n_processors,
    product_1,
    product_2,
    product_3
  )

kable(
  county_table_revenue,
  col.names = c(
    "County",
    "State",
    "Processors",
    "Top Product",
    "2nd Product",
    "3rd Product"
  ),
  caption = "Top Products by Revenue in Coastal Counties with Three or More Active Seafood Processors, 2024"
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c(
      "striped",
      "hover",
      "condensed"
    )
  )
```

### Product Type by Revenue
```{r}
### Types by county - Revenue

county_types_revenue <- products_county %>%
  group_by(geoid, type) %>%
  summarise(
    dollars = sum(dollars, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

top_3_types_revenue <- county_types_revenue %>%
  group_by(geoid) %>%
  arrange(desc(dollars), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  mutate(
    type_rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

top_3_types_revenue_wide <- top_3_types_revenue %>%
  mutate(
    type_label = paste0(
      type,
      " ($",
      scales::comma(round(dollars)),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(geoid, type_rank, type_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = type_rank,
    values_from = type_label,
    names_prefix = "type_"
  )

county_type_summary_revenue <- processor_counts %>%
  filter(n_processors >= 3) %>%
  left_join(
    top_3_types_revenue_wide,
    by = "geoid"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      starts_with("type_"),
      ~replace_na(.x, "No data")
    )
  )
```
